webappName: Missa_建筑景观_风格迁移_效果图专用
description:
这是一款面向建筑可视化与景观表现的智能风格提取应用，
它能够从参考图中精准识别并提取 天空与植被的色调、光影氛围与整体视觉风格，
用于生成具有一致环境调性的渲染、概念图或设计延展方案。

该版本针对 效果图工作流 优化，
仅保留 色彩、光感与氛围特征 的抽象捕捉，使模型能更稳定地迁移真实自然场景的情绪与光线特质。

2026/02/09提高了出图分辨率

nodeInfoList.fieldValue: Convert the 2D floor plan into a detailed 3D view with realistic lighting effects and natural shadows, including soft ambient light from ceiling lights, directional light from window sources, and warm spotlight from table lamps, while preserving the exact room layout, architectural elements, spatial arrangement, and furniture positions. Add accurate material reflectivity to surfaces such as glass, metal, and polished wood to enhance the photorealistic quality and visual depth of the scene.
